name: Memantine
mechanism: Non-competitive NMDA receptor antagonist that modulates glutamate activity
dosing: Start 5 mg once daily, increase weekly to 10 mg once daily then 10 mg twice daily (typical maintenance 20 mg/day)
contraindications: Severe renal impairment (dose adjustment required), hypersensitivity
interactions: Caution with other CNS-acting drugs; risk of confusion when combined with other NMDA antagonists
monitoring: Renal function, cognitive response, behaviour and hallucinations
clinicalPearls: Used in moderate–severe Alzheimer’s disease; may be combined with acetylcholinesterase inhibitors like donepezil.
